Offline Draft Sync Design System

A Racecraft reference for the colors, type, spacing, shape, and core interface pieces used by the offline draft sync surfaces.

Color

Palette tokens

Theme aware

Each swatch carries a token name and value so meaning is available without relying on color alone.

--rc-surface Page canvas

Dominant warm neutral surface.

--rc-surface-raised Raised panel

Use when a section needs separation.

--rc-accent Brand action

Large text and meaningful non-text only.

--rc-danger-text Critical status

Pair with a label or symbol, never color alone.
